result.brief: 提出“预测余量”指标，量化随机化动力学环境中上下文编码器可获得的单步预测信息，用于解释世界模型显式上下文推断的收益来源。
result.reason: Analyzes when randomized-dynamics environments provide predictive information for context inference in world models, formalizing "predictive headroom" — directly about world model context inference and latent dynamics.
